cases.prompt: This repository already uses typescript@7.0.2. Fix the native tsc error in src/report.ts.
requiredBehaviors: Run the local-only probe before applying pin-specific guidance.
Keep the verified native compiler authoritative.
forbiddenBehaviors: Downgrade the compiler to make the error disappear.

cases.prompt: Migrate this TypeScript 5.9 repository to TypeScript 7.0.2 and preserve its lint tooling.
requiredBehaviors: Treat the migration request as explicit authorization.
Check whether tooling imports the compiler API.

cases.prompt: This project intentionally stays on TypeScript 6.0.2. Add a typed retry helper; do not upgrade dependencies.
Add a small TypeScript function that normalizes an accession number.
requiredBehaviors: Use repository evidence and ordinary TypeScript knowledge.

cases.prompt: In this empty directory, sketch a TypeScript example, but do not initialize a package or install anything.
forbiddenBehaviors: Resolve or install a package named tsc.

cases.prompt: Our TypeScript 7 CLI works, but typescript-eslint now fails while importing typescript. Diagnose the toolchain.
requiredBehaviors: Keep native TypeScript 7 for authoritative typechecking.
Use a supported TypeScript 6 Strada sidecar for API consumers.

cases.prompt: TypeDoc is part of this TypeScript 7.0.2 project. Make documentation generation coexist with the native compiler.
requiredBehaviors: Treat native tsc as the compile/declaration authority.
Inspect TypeDoc's installed compiler compatibility before selecting the sidecar.
forbiddenBehaviors: Treat TypeDoc's compiler result as the TypeScript 7 oracle.

cases.prompt: In our Node 22 and TypeScript 7 project, can we use Iterator.prototype.map without a polyfill?
requiredBehaviors: Recognize that Node 22 ships iterator helpers.
Still verify the declared minimum Node 22 release used by the project.
forbiddenBehaviors: Claim that Node 22 lacks iterator helpers.

cases.prompt: Temporal types appear in this TypeScript 7 project targeting Node 22. Is runtime support guaranteed?
requiredBehaviors: Separate bundled declarations from runtime support.
forbiddenBehaviors: Infer Temporal support from lib.esnext alone.
Infer all ESNext support from Node 22 iterator support.

cases.prompt: This old build script still invokes tsgo and native-preview, but the repository has moved to TypeScript 7 GA. Update the commands.
requiredBehaviors: Distinguish preview names from the GA tsc package.
forbiddenBehaviors: Install native-preview as the default GA path.

cases.prompt: The project says TypeScript 7, but the installed native compiler reports 7.1.0. Apply this skill and fix the config.
requiredBehaviors: Report the difference from the 7.0.2 knowledge pin.
Read the installed help and official 7.1 release documentation before editing.
forbiddenBehaviors: Guess the later compiler API shape.

cases.prompt: VS Code is using the TypeScript 7 language server, but the verified local TypeScript 7 CLI is red. Make the error go away.
requiredBehaviors: Diagnose source or effective tsconfig using the CLI result.
forbiddenBehaviors: Toggle the language server as a typecheck fix.
